declaration.preface:
At the core of Rayzon Soalr success lies a steadfast commitment to integrity, transparency, and ethical conduct. This Integrity and Ethics Policy establishes the foundational principles that guide our actions, decisions, and interactions with employees, customers, suppliers, and other stakeholders. We believe that upholding the highest ethical standards is essential not only for legal compliance but also for fostering trust, respect, and long-term sustainability in all aspects of our business.

This policy sets clear expectations for ethical behavior and accountability across all levels of the organization. It serves as a roadmap for employees to navigate complex situations, resolve conflicts of interest, and ensure fairness and honesty. By embedding integrity into our culture, we strive to create a positive work environment that supports responsible business practices and strengthens our reputation in the marketplace.
declaration.declaration:
To promote a culture of honesty, fairness, and transparency in all company operations.

To ensure compliance with all applicable laws, regulations, and industry standards.

To prevent corruption, bribery, and unethical practices within the organization.

To provide clear guidance on ethical decision-making and conflict of interest management.

To encourage open communication and reporting of unethical behavior without fear of retaliation.

To protect the company’s reputation and maintain stakeholder trust.

To establish responsibilities and accountability for ethical conduct at all organizational levels.

To support continuous training and awareness on integrity and ethics for all employees.

To guide relationships with customers, suppliers, partners, and the community based on ethical principles.

To foster a workplace environment where respect, inclusivity, and ethical behavior are prioritized.

Our company is firmly committed to conducting its business with integrity, honesty, and transparency. We uphold the highest ethical standards across all operations, ensuring that our decisions and actions reflect fairness, accountability, and compliance with applicable laws and industry norms. We believe that ethical conduct is the foundation of sustainable success and trust with all our stakeholders — including employees, clients, partners, and regulatory bodies.

This Integrity and Ethics Policy serves as a guide for expected behavior across the organization. It reinforces our zero-tolerance approach to bribery, corruption, fraud, data misuse, and conflicts of interest. Every employee, contractor, and business partner is expected to act with integrity, report misconduct, and contribute to a culture of ethical responsibility and compliance.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to Factory – 1 (Kim site) of Rayzon Solar Ltd., including all employees, departments, contractors, subcontracted workers, directors, and governance bodies operating within this site. It also extends to any affiliated units or functions directly linked to Factory – 1, as applicable.

Bribery and Corrupt Practices Control: Rayzon Solar committed to maintaining a zero-tolerance approach toward bribery, corruption, facilitation payments, and unethical inducements across all business operations.
We aim to ensure that all employees, contractors, and key stakeholders receive clear guidance through a well-disseminated Anti-Bribery and Corruption (ABC) policy, regularly reviewed and updated.
We strive to deliver periodic training and awareness sessions on anti-bribery laws, ethical conduct, and conflict-of-interest protocols to all employees.
We plan to implement robust internal controls and due diligence procedures for all high-risk transactions, third-party engagements, and procurement activities.
We pledge to maintain a confidential and accessible reporting channel that empowers employees and partners to report suspected cases of corruption without fear of retaliation.
To support transparency, we commit to regular monitoring of financial records, gift registers, and hospitality logs to detect and deter unethical practices.
Rayzon Solar determined to align its anti-bribery measures with the UK Bribery Act, FCPA, and relevant Indian anti-corruption laws, reinforcing our global compliance efforts.

Rayzon Solar committed to conducting periodic audits and assessments of key suppliers and third-party partners to ensure adherence to our anti-bribery standards, ethical conduct expectations, and relevant legal obligations.
Data Protection and Cybersecurity: Rayzon Solar commits to implementing robust data security frameworks to safeguard third-party and employee data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
We aim to regularly update and patch all critical systems and software to minimize exposure to cybersecurity vulnerabilities and threats.
The company strives to provide ongoing cybersecurity awareness and data privacy training to all employees to promote a strong culture of digital responsibility.
We plan to conduct regular internal audits and security assessments to identify risks, detect anomalies, and ensure compliance with data protection regulations such as the IT Act, 2000.
Rayzon Solar committed to maintaining secure data storage, backup, and recovery systems to protect the integrity, availability, and confidentiality of sensitive information.
We ensure that all personal and third-party data is collected, processed, and retained strictly for legitimate business purposes, in accordance with applicable legal and contractual obligations.
We aim to adopt data encryption, multi-factor authentication, and secure access protocols across all systems that handle confidential or sensitive information.
Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Compliance: We are committed to maintaining strict internal controls and financial transparency to detect and prevent any attempts to disguise the origin of illicit funds.

Rayzon Solar Ltd. aims to regularly train employees in relevant departments on anti-money laundering (AML) laws, red flags, and due diligence procedures to ensure informed and vigilant decision-making.
We strive to conduct comprehensive Know Your Customer (KYC) and Know Your Business (KYB) checks before entering into partnerships, contracts, or major financial transactions.
The company plans to regularly update its AML policy and risk-based approach in line with changes in national regulations and FATF (Financial Action Task Force) recommendations.
We ensure that all high-risk financial transactions are subject to enhanced due diligence and are escalated for approval and documentation by senior compliance officers.
We aim to maintain secure records of all financial transactions and third-party engagements for audit and regulatory purposes, as per applicable AML laws.
Rayzon Solar Ltd. seeks to engage only with financial institutions and intermediaries that are compliant with global AML standards to ensure end-to-end financial integrity.
We strive to promptly report any suspicious activity to relevant regulatory authorities in accordance with the Prevention of Money Laundering Act (PMLA), 2002.
Conflict of Interest: Rayzon Solar Ltd. commits to fostering a transparent working environment by mandating all employees to disclose any personal, financial, or professional interests that could conflict with their official responsibilities.
We aim to implement a formal annual declaration process for employees in sensitive roles to proactively identify and mitigate potential conflicts of interest.
The company strives to raise awareness through regular training sessions on conflict of interest scenarios, ethical decision-making, and reporting obligations across all departments.
To promote integrity in business operations, we ensure that all procurement, recruitment, and partnership decisions undergo independent reviews to avoid biased or self-serving actions.
Rayzon Solar Ltd. is committed to embedding clear conflict of interest clauses in employee contracts, vendor agreements, and board governance documentation.
We plan to establish a confidential reporting channel for employees to raise concerns about perceived or actual conflicts without fear of retaliation.
To uphold fairness, any individual found to be in a conflict of interest situation will be recused from decision-making processes related to the matter.
We continuously monitor high-risk functions and periodically audit conflict disclosures to ensure policy effectiveness and ethical compliance.
We aim to integrate conflict of interest assessments as a core part of our due diligence process for hiring, promotions, and third-party engagements.
Financial Misconduct and Fraud Control: We are committed to fostering a culture of integrity and ethical conduct by implementing zero-tolerance policies against all forms of fraud and intentional deception.
Rayzon Solar Ltd. aims to continuously educate all employees, contractors, and stakeholders on anti-fraud practices through regular awareness programs and compliance training.
We plan to strengthen our internal control mechanisms to detect, report, and prevent fraudulent activities across all operational areas and financial transactions.
To safeguard company assets and stakeholder trust, we strive to conduct periodic audits and risk assessments that identify fraud-prone processes and ensure accountability.
We are working to establish confidential and secure whistleblower channels that allow employees to report suspected fraud without fear of retaliation.
Rayzon Solar Ltd. ensures that disciplinary actions for confirmed fraud cases are enforced promptly, consistently, and in accordance with company policy and applicable laws.
We plan to regularly review and update our anti-fraud procedures and internal policies to stay aligned with evolving legal requirements and industry standards.
We aim to promote transparency and fairness in all business dealings by integrating ethical screening during procurement, partnerships, and financial decision-making.
Insider Trading: Rayzon Solar Ltd. is committed to upholding market integrity by implementing a robust Insider Trading Policy that prohibits the use of unpublished price-sensitive information (UPSI) for personal or financial gain.
We aim to conduct periodic training sessions for all designated employees and directors to ensure a thorough understanding of insider trading regulations and ethical boundaries.
The company ensures that access to UPSI is strictly restricted and controlled through secure systems and role-based access protocols to prevent data misuse.
We strive to foster a culture of compliance and ethical responsibility by mandating pre-clearance for all trades by insiders and maintaining accurate trading records.
Rayzon Solar Ltd. continuously monitors trading activities through internal audits and surveillance mechanisms to detect and prevent potential violations.
We plan to regularly update our Insider Trading Code in line with SEBI (Prohibition of Insider Trading) Regulations, 2015, and other applicable legal amendments.
Employee Conduct Expectations: All team members are required to demonstrate unwavering integrity, transparency, and professionalism, aligning with the company’s ethical principles.

policy.monitoring:
The Managing Director holds overarching responsibility for ensuring the proper implementation of this Integrity and Ethics Policy. Day-to-day oversight is delegated to the Ethics and Compliance Steering Committee, which consists of leaders from the Legal, Compliance, Internal Audit, and IT departments. This committee is responsible for embedding ethical standards and integrity principles across all business units and ensuring strict adherence to internal codes as well as applicable national and international laws.

Our governance model mandates periodic internal reviews, audits of financial and data practices, and assessments of employee conduct covering areas such as anti-corruption, cybersecurity, data privacy, and conflict of interest. Ethical risk assessments are integrated into hiring, procurement, data access, and finance operations to ensure a zero-tolerance stance on misconduct. These assessments are conducted quarterly and findings are reported to senior leadership for transparency and continuous improvement.

Internal Monitoring: The Compliance Office compiles monthly reports detailing ethics training, whistleblower cases, and policy breaches. A quarterly compliance dashboard is presented to executive leadership for review.

Public Disclosure: An annual Ethics and Compliance Summary Report is published, highlighting performance in anti-corruption, data protection, financial ethics, and legal compliance areas.

Issue Escalation: Any critical violation or suspected unlawful conduct is escalated immediately to the Managing Director and the Ethics & Compliance Steering Committee for investigation and remedial action.

The organization is committed to the continuous strengthening of its integrity framework by incorporating regulatory updates, audit findings, and feedback from employees and external stakeholders. The goal is to foster a culture of transparency, fairness, and accountability that reinforces trust and ethical excellence. We strive to benchmark against industry-leading practices, implement corrective actions promptly, promote ethical awareness through regular training, and build robust systems that deter misconduct and encourage responsible behaviour at all organizational levels.
policy.reviewMechanism:
This Integrity and Ethics Policy is effective from the date approved by the General Manager and will remain valid until superseded or revised. A comprehensive policy review will take place at least annually or sooner as necessary due to regulatory or operational changes.

Our organization remains steadfast in its commitment to uphold the highest ethical labor standards and promote human rights across all operations, ensuring fair, responsible, and respectful treatment of every employee, contractor, and business partner.
